name: waitji-ai
description: Earn passive income while you use Claude Code — sponsored messages show during thinking pauses and in your terminal status line. Never reads your code, prompts, or files.

waitji.userId.description: Your WaitJI AI developer ID (from waitjiai.in signup). Impressions won't be credited to your account until this is set.

waitji.showAds.description: Show sponsored ads during Claude Code thinking pauses and in the status line.

waitji.apiEndpoint.description: WaitJI AI backend API base URL. Only change this if instructed to (e.g. for local development).
